intendedChanges.summary: Increase provider publication frequency from quarterly to monthly.
Reduce the grant ceiling from $120,000 to $60,000; District can counter with a higher ceiling for documented accessibility costs.
Extend record-examination notice from ten to twenty business days, delaying Office oversight.
Shorten deficiency correction from thirty to ten days; District can counter with an extension upon timely submission of a corrective schedule.
Reduce the maximum monthly assessment from $500 to $100, weakening the Office enforcement remedy.
Move the unchanged worksheet-retention clause from Section 4 to Section 8.
Use aggregated instead of aggregate in the annual-review description as a neutral wording clean-up.
Replace stated with specified in the day-count convention without changing its operation.
